fields.summary: The plan session for change set 01M5WPTZ1V0JVVW8FPX0QYMRWJ (the review workflow) on 2026-10-27, within milestone 3's review-workflow-shape decision. The owner answered five topics by picking the agent's recommended option every time, typing nothing. Decided: a new `checks` step kind runs the agent checks as fresh sessions in parallel, each in a pane, and re-runs only the failed ones. The built-in review starts with a code check (`rhiza check`, `rhiza run build-check`, and the repo's own command through a workflow override), then runs five agent checks (compliance, quality, hands-on QA with the built binary, scope, model). Checks and critics run on opus. `rhiza run findings` and `rhiza run verdict` gain a `check` field and severities (blocker, major, minor, nit), each finding optionally naming a leaf. A critic runs only for a check with a blocker or major finding, can't add findings, and a check fails only on a confirmed blocker or major. Minors and nits are reported, not fixed. A confirmed finding goes to a fixer per leaf, whose fix commit carries the leaf's `Leaf:` trailer, and then the leaf's verifier runs again. Findings naming no leaf go to one change-set fixer with a `Review:` trailer, and scope findings needing outside work become questions or discovered-from drafts. After 2 fix cycles the surviving findings become questions and the run fails before sign-off; a resume after an answer gets one fresh cycle, and the arbiter answers in autonomous runs. The owner signs off with `rhiza run approve` or `rhiza run request-changes <file>` (owner findings, already confirmed, one extra cycle outside the cap), and autonomous runs skip the wait. `rhiza run summary` renders the verdicts as markdown; the PR body is change set 8's. The QA check records Evidence on the leaves it exercised, the model check proposes missing constraints in a discovered-from draft, and dropped findings stay in the journal. Each check and critic works in a throwaway detached worktree at the branch head and reviews from the merge-base with the default branch. Left open: what a failing code check does.
